title: skills(objectstack-data): the /data refusal bound and details.refusals are taught for the REST routes only; a host serving /data through the runtime dispatcher is untraced
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgV6i8jfWwSXjpWJrjA

Filing gate: ① (an out-of-scope finding of a dev report, escalated by the contract review) · Source: fleet (PR #38182, the card thread's report 7235308567 on #38161 and contract review 7235392160, nit N1)

## What happens

After PR #38182, `skills/objectstack-data/references/data-hooks.md` teaches that `/data` cuts a declared `userMessage` at 500 characters and returns the full `details.refusals`. Both facts were read on `@objectstack/rest`'s routes (`mapDataError`, `CLIENT_MESSAGE_MAX` in `packages/types/src/data-error-classification.ts`). A host that serves `/data` through `HttpDispatcher.dispatch()` sends a thrown refusal through `errorResponseBase` (`packages/runtime/src/dispatcher-plugin.ts`) or the host's catch-all, and neither the dev nor the reviewer traced what that path answers. The skill says `/data` without saying which server answers it.

## Expected

- [ ] Read what the dispatcher path answers for a declared hook refusal: the message bound, and whether `details.refusals` survives.
- [ ] If it matches the REST routes, nothing changes. If it differs, either the path is brought in line (a code card of its own) or the skill names the server its sentence is about. The file sits at its token ceiling, so any added text is paid for by a cut.

`skills/**` is Tier H.

Grade: area:ai · documentation · reach: one sentence in a published skill, on one hosting path · evidence: read (contract review 7235392160)
Suggested-grade: p3
Size: XS
Related: #38161, #37642, PR #38182.
